flash_write_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Customize the frequency in which data is flushed to the flash. This setting helps to prevent rapid changes to a component from being quickly written to the flash and wearing it out. Defaults to `1min`. Set to `never` to disable this feature.

*See also: [ESPHome Core Configuration](https://next.esphome.io/components/esphome#configuration-variables)*
